label.en: Selected universe / 宇宙 sound and continuity sub-mappings
label.zh-Hans: universe／宇宙的声音与连续性子映射

title.en: W → WATER / WETNESS / WAVE-FLOW semantic enrichment
title.zh-Hans: W → 水／湿润／波动—流动语义富集

lexical_meaning.en: The visible region above the earth.
lexical_meaning.zh-Hans: 从地面向上看见的广大空间。

etymology_evidence.en: These are ordinary lexical equivalents; the page does not claim that the English, Chinese and French forms share an origin.
etymology_evidence.zh-Hans: 这些是日常词汇对应；词条不主张英、汉、法语形式具有共同起源。

notes.en: Lexical equivalence is distinct from historical cognacy.
notes.zh-Hans: 词汇对应不等于历史同源。

candidate_cross_language_mappings.phonetic_relation: sky /skaɪ/ ↔ 盖 /kaɪ/: comparable /aɪ/ and velar consonants; initial /s/, voicing and tone do not correspond.

etymology_evidence.en: Gaitian supplies a documented cultural cover metaphor, but no regular sound correspondence, borrowing path or documentary chain establishes cognacy.
etymology_evidence.zh-Hans: 盖天说提供有文献的覆盖隐喻，但没有规律音变、借词路径或文献链证明同源。

notes.en: A proposed Unilanguage mapping, not a standard translation or established etymology.
notes.zh-Hans: 这是 Unilanguage 候选映射，不是标准翻译或已确立词源。

notes.en: Complete demonstration case with explicit evidence boundaries.
notes.zh-Hans: 完整示范案例，包含明确证据边界。

lexical_meaning.en: The totality of space, time, matter and energy; also a complete conceptual world.
lexical_meaning.zh-Hans: 空间、时间、物质与能量的整体；也可指完整的概念世界。

etymology_evidence.en: The English and Chinese expressions are not presented as cognates. The comparison concerns totalizing semantic structure.
etymology_evidence.zh-Hans: 英语与汉语表达不被视为同源；这里比较的是整体化语义结构。

notes.en: The source page keeps the overall case at Level C; selected sub-mappings may be Level B candidates.
notes.zh-Hans: 源词条将整体案例保持为 C 级；部分子映射可作为 B 级候选。

etymology_evidence.en: Homophony permits investigation but does not establish shared etymology or unrestricted semantic identity.
etymology_evidence.zh-Hans: 同音可作为调查线索，但不证明共同词源或不受限制的语义同一。

notes.en: Published as a reviewed hypothesis label, not as a validated historical claim.
notes.zh-Hans: 作为经审核的假说标签发布，不作为已验证的历史主张。

notes.en: Demonstrates semantic-structure and phonetic-candidate mappings in one general renderer.
notes.zh-Hans: 用同一通用渲染器展示语义结构与语音候选映射。

lexical_meaning.en: An adult male human; historically, also a person or human being in some uses.
lexical_meaning.zh-Hans: 成年男性；部分历史用法中也可泛指人。

candidate_cross_language_mappings.phonetic_relation: /mæn/ ↔ nán: compact nasal-bounded syllables; m ↔ n remains an experimental correspondence.

etymology_evidence.en: The core meanings overlap strongly, but no documented transmission path or regular historical sound correspondence establishes cognacy.
etymology_evidence.zh-Hans: 核心词义高度重合，但没有文献传播路径或规律历史音变证明同源。

notes.en: Level A is the source page's provisional mapping score, not historical certainty and not a statistically calibrated result.
notes.zh-Hans: A 级来自源词条的暂定映射评分，不等于历史确定性，也不是统计校准结果。

notes.en: The secondary man ↔ 氓 case remains outside the public canonical mapping until reading-sensitive review is complete.
notes.zh-Hans: man ↔ 氓 辅助案例在完成读音敏感审核前不进入公开 canonical mapping。

lexical_meaning.en: The preregistered W-initial lexical-family condition evaluated in UNI-EXP-002.
lexical_meaning.zh-Hans: UNI-EXP-002 中预注册评估的 W 起始词族条件。

candidate_cross_language_mappings.mapping_form: W → WATER / WETNESS / WAVE-FLOW semantic family
candidate_cross_language_mappings.phonetic_relation: The tested condition was W-initial lexical families; the result does not establish a universal sound law.

etymology_evidence.en: This is a preregistered enrichment test, not an etymological claim. Direction matched the hypothesis, but evidence was insufficient.
etymology_evidence.zh-Hans: 这是预注册富集检验，不是词源主张；方向与假说一致，但证据不足。

notes.en: Primary status is INCONCLUSIVE: W 7/120 (5.83%), Controls 9/240 (3.75%), RR 1.556, 95% CI 0.594–4.075, RD +2.08 pp, 95% CI −4.12 to +9.57, Fisher p=.4185.
A research-condition record, not a normal dictionary equivalence.
notes.zh-Hans: 这是研究条件记录，不是普通词典对应。

lexical_meaning.en: A structured system used to communicate and interpret meaning.
lexical_meaning.zh-Hans: 用于交流和解释意义的结构化系统。

etymology_evidence.en: The source page records English language through Old French langage and Latin lingua. Chinese and French forms are presented as lexical equivalents, not as shared-origin proof.
etymology_evidence.zh-Hans: 源词条记录英语 language 经古法语 langage 与拉丁语 lingua 的词汇历史；汉语与法语形式作为词汇对应，不作为共同起源证明。

notes.en: Exploratory lang/朗/浪 and related sound associations from the source page are intentionally excluded from this published mapping pending separate review.
notes.zh-Hans: 源词条中的 lang／朗／浪等探索性声音关联暂不纳入正式映射，等待独立审核。

notes.en: Package E research audit: ordinary lexical mapping only; speculative material remains outside the canonical record.
notes.zh-Hans: Package E 研究审核：仅纳入普通词汇对应；推测性内容保留在 canonical record 之外。

lexical_meaning.en: Vibration that can be heard; in language, the audible medium of speech.
lexical_meaning.zh-Hans: 可被听见的振动；在语言中也是言语的可听媒介。

etymology_evidence.en: The source page records these ordinary lexical equivalents. Similar initial sounds are not used here as historical or common-origin evidence.
etymology_evidence.zh-Hans: 源词条记录这些普通词汇对应；这里不把相似的起始音当作历史关系或共同起源证据。

notes.en: Proposed sound-pattern comparisons in the source page remain hypotheses and are excluded from this published lexical mapping.
notes.zh-Hans: 源词条中的声音模式比较仍属假说，不纳入本条正式词汇映射。

notes.en: Package E research audit: ordinary lexical equivalence only.
notes.zh-Hans: Package E 研究审核：仅纳入普通词汇对应。
